pages.title: Day 3: Tidal Surge / Day 12: Nightscape / Bonus Round
pages.text: Tidal Surge is Day 3 of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995). The same tune plays on Day 12, Nightscape, and in the bonus round.

pages.title: The bonus round
pages.text: In the bonus round of Vectorman, the player is a green sphere in the center of the screen, and enemies come in from the sides. There is a one-minute timer. Surviving gives a Success Bonus of 25,000 points, and losing still gives a Loser Bonus of 5,000, says Sega Retro. To get in, the player has to find and destroy a satellite dish.
